description: Post a promoted (paid) message. `value` funds endorser payouts; set it to maximum_number_of_paid_endorsers × payment_per_endorser. Accounts whose interests contain target_interests are paid when they elevate it. Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

confirm_token.description: Token from the first call, to confirm this irreversible action

maximum_number_of_paid_endorsers.description: Non-negative integer as a string of digits

new_message.description: UTF-8 text, at most 2048 bytes; no control or invisible characters

payment_per_endorser.description: Amount in GEODE as a decimal string (e.g. "1.25"), or {"raw": "<planck>"}

photo_or_youtube_link.description: https:// URL or empty string, at most 512 bytes

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

target_interests.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

value.description: GEODE to send with this call (explicit; never inferred)

website_or_document_link.description: https:// URL or empty string, at most 512 bytes

name: geode_social_send_paid_message_public
title: Social: send paid message public
